warnings: This problem is framed as statistics/probability using a bar chart; there is no geometric computation (area/angle). If one expects a geometric question, ensure the prompt clarifies it's about bar chart interpretation rather than geometry.
validation_details: Validation checked: GEOMETRIC VALIDITY - No geometric shape area/perimeter/angle to compute; bars are standard bar chart, no triangle/collinearity issues. QUESTION-DIAGRAM MATCH - Diagram description includes bars X, Y, Z with counts 5,9,12; axis labels Count (vertical) and X,Y,Z on horizontal; The numbers correspond to the counts; No mismatch. SOLVABILITY - Information sufficient: total = 5+9+12=26; probability P(Y)=9/26; No contradictory constraints. TERMINOLOGY ACCURACY - Terms used are correct for a bar chart/probability question; No misuse of geometry terms.
